_comment: Tanium API Gateway (GraphQL) source config.  Read by Sources/Tanium/TaniumClient.py
Base_Url is the full GraphQL endpoint path, not just the host.
API_Key is the Tanium API token including its 'token-' prefix.  Auth is sent as the 'session' header.
Page sizing adapts at runtime: start at Page_Size_Start, halve on load-related failure,
lock in the first size that works, hard abort at Page_Size_Min.  Tanium recommends ~100
for compliance/cveFindings payloads - seed Page_Size_Start from a census run's locked size.
Queue_Max_Size is backpressure only - work items carry an id, not the endpoint payload.
Run tanium_runner.py --mode preflight to confirm connectivity and token validity.
